newsitem.title: GERMANY: DSL Bank says BHW has reduced stake.
newsitem.headline: DSL Bank says BHW has reduced stake.

text.p: DSL Holding AG, the holding company for Germany's state-controlled Deutsche Siedlungs und Landesrentenbank (DSL Bank), said on Wednesday that its shareholder BHW-Gesellschaft fuer Wohnungswirtschaft mbH had cut its DSL stake to just above 10 percent.
BHW had a stake of 20.69 percent in DSL in February.
In an obligatory statement, DSL also said that it would raise its dividend for the 1996/1997 business year ended July 31 to 10 marks ($5.29) per share plus a tax break of 4.29 marks.
That marked an 85 percent increase from the previous year's payout, the bank said. ($ = 1.889 German Marks)
